fact_text: Book building for the Service Long March Tyres IPO was heavily oversubscribed, with bids for about 2.3 billion shares against 292 million offered.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: The total issue of about 387 million shares comprised 292 million offered in book building and about 97 million left for the e-IPO.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: On a PKR 2 million application, the analyst estimated an allocation of only about 12,500 shares because of the heavy oversubscription.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: A Chinese parent holds about 42.57% of Service Long March Tyres, so the IPO is also described as a Chinese-linked listing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Service Industries holds about 21.37% and Service Global Footwear about 18.30% of Service Long March Tyres; both are listed companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: The IM shows about PKR 50 billion of sales from existing truck and bus tyre plants, and a projection of about PKR 100 billion for 2027 once radial tyres are added.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Budget proposals under discussion would cut fibre-optic import duty from above 60% to 5% and reduce provincial taxes of about 19.5% on broadband internet, which would make broadband cheaper.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: PTC reported Q1 2026 group revenue of about PKR 97 billion, against about PKR 62 billion a year earlier, and gross margin rose to about PKR 34 to 35 billion from about PKR 19 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: PTC's books show long-term debt of about PKR 232 billion and short-term debt of about PKR 64 billion, with finance charges of about PKR 14 to 15 billion in the quarter.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Jet fuel is supplied to commercial aviation at about PKR 320 per litre, while petrol is around PKR 411 per litre, which the analyst said leaves refiners little margin on jet fuel.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: The analyst expected refiners to earn a thinner margin on jet fuel than on high speed diesel and petrol, which make up most of refinery consumption.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: The analyst said National Refinery's Q3 FY26 results improved mainly because higher ex-refinery prices lifted margins.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Lucky Motor was set to launch an EV model on 20 May 2026, which the analyst said was an important launch for the company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Gillette Pakistan's sponsors announced a voluntary delisting from the PSX at PKR 700 per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: The analyst noted that PTC's group, in the reported period, faced Ufone's market share rising toward about 35% after the Telenor merger, from about 23% before.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)

fact_text: Pakistan is energy deficient and imports crude, petrol and high speed diesel, so higher oil prices widen the import bill and pressure the trade deficit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SLM 2.3bn Shares Subscribed | Gillette Rs700 Delisting | Midday Flash 19 May 2026' (YouTube, 2026-05-19)
